battle.name: 愛爾蘭內戰
battle.brief: 愛爾蘭內戰於1922年6月爆發，反對《英愛條約》的國民軍與支持條約的自由邦軍在愛爾蘭交戰，戰線涵蓋都柏林、科克及德羅赫達等地。別丹步槍（Berdan rifle）於1866年列裝，是蘇俄陸軍制式步槍，亦為愛爾蘭國民軍使用的步兵裝備。

kit.name: 別丹步槍
kit.history: 別丹步槍（Berdan rifle）是蘇俄陸軍的制式栓動步槍，配置於步兵分隊，負責提供主要射擊火力，屬地面部隊的標準制式武器。

countries: 1922年的參戰格局並非兩個對等國家。條約一方是於1922年12月依憲制成立的愛爾蘭自由邦，其軍事核心為愛爾蘭國民軍；另一方是拒絕《英愛條約》的反條約愛爾蘭共和軍，它不是受外國指揮的軍隊。當時正式國名仍為大不列顛及愛爾蘭聯合王國；北愛爾蘭是王國內的自治區，而非此時的正式國名。王國在北愛爾蘭維持英軍與皇家烏爾斯特警察隊防線，其後以地面部隊、裝甲車、火砲、軍械及有限的英國皇家空軍支援自由邦。戰區由都柏林、貝爾法斯特、德里與紐里，經基爾肯尼、韋克斯福德、基爾代爾、蒂珀雷里、沃特福德、科克及梅奧伸入南部。自由邦初期控制都柏林、港口與幹線鐵路；反條約軍在進攻高峰占據數座郡城和廣大鄉區，卻始終未能穩固控制都柏林。
countriesEn: The belligerent structure in 1922 was not one between two equal states. On the Treaty side was the Irish Free State, which came into constitutional existence in December 1922, with the Irish National Army as its military core. The other side was the anti-Treaty Irish Republican Army, which was not a force under foreign command. The official name of the state was still the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland; Northern Ireland was an autonomous area within that kingdom, not a sovereign state bearing that name. The United Kingdom maintained British troops and the Royal Ulster Constabulary in Northern Ireland, then supported the Free State with ground forces, armoured cars, artillery, weapons and limited assistance from the Royal Air Force. The theatre ran from Dublin, Belfast, Derry and Newry through Kilkenny, Wexford, Kildare, Tipperary, Waterford, Cork and Mayo. The Free State initially held Dublin, the ports and the main railway lines. At the height of their offensive, the anti-Treaty forces occupied several county towns and broad rural areas, but never gained firm control of Dublin.
people: 前線權責分散在政治領袖、支部指揮官與英軍指揮體系之間。邁克爾·柯林斯主持臨時政府，主導自由邦在都柏林的反攻，並於1922年8月22日在科克郡貝爾納布拉特遭伏擊身亡；湯姆·麥克寇廷在科克指揮反條約軍，8月25日陣亡；埃米特·達爾頓率科克守軍戰至8月後投降。約瑟夫·麥克布萊德負責都柏林郵政總局，卡撒爾·布魯哈組織市區抵抗。愛爾蘭國民軍方面，埃蒙·奧達菲協調都柏林戰區，厄內斯特·史密斯率巴勞縱隊收復南線；英軍總司令約翰·泰勒爵士及英國皇家空軍提供部隊、軍械與偵察。埃蒙·德·瓦萊拉是反條約政治領袖，而非各戰場的戰術指揮者；法蘭克·艾肯於1923年4月底出任愛爾蘭共和軍參謀長，並在5月底主導停火。
peopleEn: Responsibility on the battlefield was divided among political leaders, local commanders and the British command structure. Michael Collins chaired the Provisional Government, directed the Free State counteroffensive in Dublin and was killed in an ambush at Béal na Bláth in County Cork on 22 August 1922. Tom MacCurtain commanded anti-Treaty forces in Cork and was killed on 25 August. Emmet Dalton led the Cork defenders until their surrender in August. Joseph McBride commanded at the Dublin General Post Office, while Cathal Brugha organised resistance in the city. On the National Army side, Éamon O'Duffy coordinated operations in Dublin, and Ernest Smith led the Barrow Column as it recovered the southern line. British Commander-in-Chief Sir John Taylor and the Royal Air Force supplied troops, weapons and reconnaissance. Éamon de Valera led the anti-Treaty political movement but did not personally direct tactical formations in the field. Frank Aiken became Chief of Staff of the Irish Republican Army in late April 1923 and guided the ceasefire at the end of May.
kits: 雙方使用的武器均為1922年或更早已列裝的真實型號。反條約愛爾蘭共和軍可使用英國Pattern 1895 Mk I長身李-恩菲爾德步槍、1907年列裝的Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk I短身李-恩菲爾德步槍、Howth Mauser Model 1916步槍，以及數量有限的Browning Automatic Rifle Model 1917；近戰火器包括Thompson Model 1921機槍，手槍則有Webley Mk I .45口徑轉輪手槍。愛爾蘭國民軍大量接收英軍制式.303口徑步槍、Lewis Gun Mk I、Vickers .303 Mark I輕機槍與Webley手槍，並取得QF 18-pounder Mk I野戰砲和QF 4.5-inch howitzer Mk I榴彈砲。英軍還使用Rolls-Royce 1914 Pattern裝甲車，自由邦後勤則使用Ford Model T載貨車、汽車與鐵路。實際上，同一支反條約隊伍可能同時攜有.303、7.65毫米、.30-06及.45 ACP彈藥，基金管理、零件供應與轉載極為繁重；國民軍的優勢不在射手數量，而在於較一致的.303口徑及能持續配送的火砲與機槍。
kitsEn: The weapons used by both sides were real models already in service by 1922 or earlier. Anti-Treaty Irish Republican Army units could use the British Pattern 1895 Mk I Long Lee-Enfield rifle, the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk I introduced in 1907, the Howth Mauser Model 1916 rifle and smaller quantities of the Browning Automatic Rifle Model 1917. Close-support weapons included the Thompson Model 1921 submachine gun, while the Webley Mk I .45 revolver was a common sidearm. The Irish National Army inherited large quantities of standard .303-calibre rifles, Lewis Gun Mk I machine guns, Vickers .303 Mark I light machine guns and Webley revolvers from British stocks. It also obtained QF 18-pounder Mk I field guns and QF 4.5-inch howitzer Mk I. British forces used Rolls-Royce 1914 Pattern armoured cars, while Free State logistics relied on Ford Model T lorries, motor cars and railways. In practice, an anti-Treaty unit might carry .303, 7.65mm, .30-06 and .45 ACP ammunition at the same time, making finance, spare parts and transshipment a serious burden. The National Army's advantage was not a larger number of riflemen, but more standardised .303 ammunition and a dependable supply of artillery and machine guns.
tactics: 戰法隨戰區而變。六月下旬，反條約軍先以縱隊奪取都柏林郵政總局、兵營、車站與數座郡城，再圖切斷通往首都的鐵路和公路。市區作戰中，守軍利用上層樓房、狹窄街口與交叉射界建立據點，並以炸藥包阻止裝甲車接近；英軍裝甲車及火砲介入後，郵政總局守軍才在持續砲火下退卻。愛爾蘭國民軍避免讓小分隊深入鄉間，而以鐵路輸送步兵，以汽車牽引裝甲車與十八磅砲，逐點恢復交通線；厄內斯特·史密斯率巴勞縱隊由都柏林經紐布里奇、阿克洛、恩尼斯科蒂和韋克斯福德南下，在七月中旬切斷反條約軍在南部各郡之間的連繫。八月以後，反條約軍改採游擊戰：小隊夜間以步槍、自行車、馬匹及少量車輛移動，襲擊駐軍、軍械庫與運輸隊，伏擊巡邏，並破壞鐵路和通訊。國民軍則以武裝巡邏、封鎖區、機動搜索縱隊、裝甲車及火砲追擊，並由英軍航空隊提供有限偵察。
tacticsEn: Methods changed with the theatre. In late June, anti-Treaty columns seized the Dublin General Post Office, barracks, railway stations and several county towns before attempting to cut the roads and railways leading to the capital. In urban fighting, defenders used upper floors, narrow junctions and intersecting fields of fire to form strongpoints, employing satchel charges against approaching armoured cars. Only after British armoured cars and artillery entered the fight did the Post Office garrison withdraw under sustained bombardment. The National Army avoided sending small detachments deep into the countryside. It moved infantry by rail, towed armoured cars and 18-pounders along the roads and recovered communications point by point. Ernest Smith's Barrow Column moved south from Dublin through Newbridge, Arklow, Enniscorthy and Wexford, cutting the anti-Treaty link between the southern counties in mid-July. After August, the IRA shifted to guerrilla methods. Small groups moved at night with rifles, bicycles, horses and occasional vehicles, raided garrisons and depots, ambushed patrols and damaged railways and communications. The National Army answered with armed patrols, security zones, mobile search columns, armoured cars and artillery, while British aircraft provided limited observation.
data: 可交叉核對的時間骨架如下：《英愛條約》於1921年12月6日簽訂，愛爾蘭國民議會於1922年1月7日批准；反條約軍占據都柏林四法院是6月18日，自由邦與英軍砲擊後，守軍於6月24日投降。IRA在6月27日控制郵政總局，28日把行動擴展為全國性進攻，都柏林戰鬥延續至7月5日。反條約軍於7月2日占領洛基，5日至6日短暫控制阿克隆，6日至8日攻入德羅赫達，8日至12日控制科克，戰線又向梅奧與蒂珀雷里延伸；巴勞縱隊在7月10日至19日由都柏林南下，奪回阿克洛、恩尼斯科蒂、韋克斯福德及數處交通點。愛爾蘭共和軍在科克鄉區的抵抗延至1922年秋，1923年4月9日至16日又與國民軍在克朗穆爾特交戰。各方沒有可靠的逐日兵籍：自由邦總名冊很快達數萬人，IRA的分散支部只有部分能同時投入一地，英軍則在北部維持駐軍並在都柏林直接投入部隊與裝甲車。戰爭造成數千名交戰者死亡，受傷者更多；因陣亡、失聯、投降後死亡及處決的統計口徑不同，沒有可信的單一精確總表，因此不能替單一戰役虛構傷亡數字。
dataEn: The verifiable chronological framework is as follows. The Anglo-Irish Treaty was signed on 6 December 1921 and approved by Dáil Éireann on 7 January 1922. Anti-Treaty forces occupied the Four Courts in Dublin on 18 June; after shelling by Free State and British forces, the garrison surrendered on 24 June. The IRA took control of the General Post Office on 27 June and expanded its action into a nationwide offensive on 28 June, with fighting in Dublin continuing to 5 July. The anti-Treaty IRA occupied Limerick on 2 July, briefly held Athlone from 5 to 6 July, entered Drogheda between 6 and 8 July, and controlled Cork from 8 to 12 July before extending the front into Mayo and Tipperary. Between 10 and 19 July, the Barrow Column advanced south from Dublin and recovered Arklow, Enniscorthy, Wexford and several communications points. IRA resistance in the Cork countryside continued through the autumn of 1922, followed by the battle at Clonmult from 9 to 16 April 1923. There are no reliable day-by-day personnel returns. The Free State's official rolls quickly reached tens of thousands, but only part of the IRA's dispersed branches could be committed in one place. British troops remained in the north and directly supported Dublin operations with troops and armoured cars. Thousands of combatants were killed and more were wounded. Because records differ in their treatment of deaths in action, missing men, deaths after surrender and executions, there is no credible single exact total, and no invented casualty figure should be assigned to an individual battle.
cause: 內戰的根源是《英愛條約》造成的憲制與軍事分裂。條約保留英國國君，設立參議院、國務院並載有三年條款，同時要求愛爾蘭共和軍放下武器。柯林斯與支持條約者認為，唯有建立可運作的政府、議會和安全力量，分裂的共和軍才會接受命令；德·瓦萊拉與反條約派則認為，君主制的法律延續、對軍隊的約束及短暫過渡安排，不能成為共和主權的最終基礎。IRA因而出現明顯分裂，部分支部轉入愛爾蘭國民軍，其餘單位拒絕停火。英軍仍在愛爾蘭駐紮，雙方也都不相信對方會解除武裝，使爭執持續累積。直接轉為內戰的事件發生於1922年6月：反條約軍於18日占據四法院，英軍與自由邦部隊介入並在22日施以砲火，守軍於24日投降。27日IRA控制郵政總局，28日各地同時攻擊政府設施，原本可用政治談判處理的分裂，遂發展為全國性軍事戰爭。
causeEn: The roots of the Civil War lay in the constitutional and military division created by the Anglo-Irish Treaty. The Treaty retained the British monarch, established a Senate and Council of State, included a three-year clause and required the Irish Republican Army to surrender its weapons. Collins and the pro-Treaty side argued that a functioning government, parliament and security force were necessary before the divided IRA would accept an order. De Valera and the anti-Treaty faction maintained that the legal continuation of monarchy, constraints upon the armed forces and a short transitional arrangement could not form the final basis of republican sovereignty. The IRA consequently split, with some branches entering the Irish National Army while others refused to stand down. British forces remained stationed in Ireland, and neither side trusted the other to disarm, so the dispute accumulated military force. The immediate transition to civil war came in June 1922. Anti-Treaty troops occupied the Four Courts on the 18th, British and Free State forces intervened and opened fire on the 22nd, and the garrison surrendered on the 24th. The IRA took the General Post Office on the 27th, and attacks on government targets began simultaneously across the country on the 28th. A political rupture that might still have been managed by negotiation became a nationwide military conflict.
impact: 戰爭最直接的軍事結果，是自由邦重新掌握都柏林、港口、鐵路與南部交通線，並將反條約軍逐出主要城市；愛爾蘭國民軍也在持續戰鬥中建立較完整的指揮、補給、砲兵運用及機動搜索制度，成為此後常備軍的骨架。反條約派失去大部分裝甲車、火砲與正規部隊，無法在全國維持可持續的替代政府；其後續影響因此主要轉入政治組織，而非公開戰爭。1923年2月成立、由德·瓦萊拉領導的法蘭克·費爾黨在6月選舉取得127席中的63席，雖未過半數，卻顯示反條約力量已轉化為強大的議會反對力量。自由邦依《條約》維持國家機構，北愛爾蘭的邊界與自治安排仍然存在；同年秋，自由邦獲准加入國際聯盟，得到更廣泛的外交承認。戰俘審訊、軍法處置和雙方報復所累積的政治仇恨，也使軍隊獲勝與社會和解之間留下長期距離。
impactEn: The most immediate military effect was the Free State's recovery of Dublin, the ports, the railways and the southern transport network, followed by the reduction of the anti-Treaty army's hold on the principal towns. Through continuous operations, the Irish National Army developed integrated command, supply, artillery employment and mobile search procedures that formed the basis of its later permanent force. The anti-Treaty side lost most of its armoured cars, artillery and regular formations and could no longer sustain an alternative government across the country. Its subsequent influence consequently moved into political organisation rather than open warfare. Fianna Fáil, formed under de Valera in February 1923, won 63 of 127 seats in the June election. Although this was not an absolute majority, it demonstrated that anti-Treaty sentiment had become a major parliamentary opposition. The Free State retained its institutions under the Treaty, while the border and autonomous arrangements of Northern Ireland remained in place. Admission to the League of Nations later that year brought wider diplomatic recognition. Trials of prisoners, military sentences and retaliatory actions also accumulated political bitterness, leaving a long distance between military victory and reconciliation.
result: 到1923年春，愛爾蘭國民軍在科克、沃特福德、蒂珀雷里與洛基一帶集中步兵、火砲、裝甲車及由鐵路和載貨車維持的後勤，逐個奪取城鎮、車站與軍械庫，並切斷反條約支部之間的往來。4月9日至16日的克朗穆爾特戰鬥，是反條約軍最後幾次大規模集中兵力之一；此後其南部據點被逐一壓縮，五月再於科克、蒂珀雷里及沃特福德發動襲擊，也未能建立持久控制區。5月30日，艾肯宣布停火，6月2日要求前線停止行動；多數支部接受命令，準備投降或解散，但部分地方單位仍拒絕服從，在六月及七月初繼續作戰，因此不同史料對正式結束日略有差異。到七月初，最後有組織的縱隊已被解除武裝、捕獲或解散，零星遲延行動亦告停止。自由邦保有二十六郡、首都、主要港口與鐵路，反條約軍的公開軍事階段失敗，沒有建立獲廣泛承認的替代國家；然而愛爾蘭共和軍作為政治反對力量的歷史仍在延續，這使1923年之後的憲制衝突轉入議會與政治鬥爭。
resultEn: By the spring of 1923, the Irish National Army had concentrated infantry, artillery, armoured cars and a supply system based on railways and lorries around Cork, Waterford, Tipperary and Limerick. It took towns, stations and depots one by one and cut the movement of anti-Treaty detachments between them. The battle at Clonmult from 9 to 16 April was among the last occasions on which the anti-Treaty forces concentrated substantial strength. Their southern positions were subsequently compressed, and further attacks in Cork, Tipperary and Waterford during May failed to create a durable area of control. Aiken announced a ceasefire on 30 May, with front-line units instructed to stop operations on 2 June. Most branches accepted the order and prepared to surrender or disband, but some local units refused and continued fighting during June and the opening days of July, producing slight differences in the final date given by different chronologies. By early July, the last organised columns had been disarmed, captured or dispersed, and the remaining isolated actions had ended. The Free State retained the twenty-six counties, the capital, the principal ports and the railways. The anti-Treaty army's open military phase had failed, and no alternative state with broad recognition emerged. The history of the IRA nevertheless continued as a political opposition, moving the constitutional conflict after 1923 into parliamentary and political struggle.
